title: I'LL BE THERE
lyrics_plain:
You and I must make a pack
we must bring salvation back
Where there is love, I'll be there
I'll reach out my hand to you
I'll have faith in all you do
Just call my name and I'll be there
I'll be there to comfort you
Build my world of dreams around you
I'm so glad I found you
I'll be there with a love that's strong
I'll be your strength
I'll keep you holding on
Let me fill your heart with joy and laughter
Togetherness is all I'm after
Whenever you need me, I'll be there
I'll be there to protect you
with an unselfish love I'll respect you
Just call my name and I'll be there
I'll be there to comfort you
Build my world of dreams around you
I'm so glad I found you
I'll be there with a love that's strong
I'll be your strength
I'll keep you holding on
If you should ever find someone new
I know she'd better be good to you
'Cause if she doesn't, I'll be there
I'll be there, I'll be there
Just call my name, I'll be there
I'll be there, I'll be there
Whenever you need me, I'll be thereReset VolumeReset PanReset ExpressionReset Pitch WheelReset Modulation WheelReset Aftertouch
